title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode7 Uncertainty

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Line: School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A part of me doesn't want everyone to hear Miku sing songs that I don't feel are 100% the right choices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I have so many precious memories involving her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I didn't realize that was how I actually felt...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never really thought about it until now.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Because I was genuinely excited by the thought of singing with Miku, and hearing her sing a song that I'd written just for her for the very first time was so much fun too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never thought that I'd feel this way about writing a song for her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, what do we do about that collaboration...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Based on the theme we were given, I feel that we can write a song that I'd want Miku to sing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I won't really know until we actually finish writing it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (After accepting that offer, our song might end up turning into something completely different. We can't rule that out...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Until now, we've been having Miku sing songs that we genuinely felt were right for her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now, we have to make something that Miku can sing if we want to do this collaboration...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel like I'd be forcing myself...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't know what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But this collaboration is a massive opportunity for Leo/need...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thinking about our future, we should accept their offer...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We should, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is Ichi gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's been up on the rooftop thinking ever since the others left.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll be fine...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe she'll come up with an answer that will make her happy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You say that, but aren't you worried the most...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I'm obviously worried about her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because Ichika made it clear just how much I mean to her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was also really moved by what Ichi said!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you basically meant everything to her ever since she was little!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was also a little surprised to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what she said made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In the past, Ichika struggled to understand her true feelings, which made it harder for her to write songs...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But now, she's not willing to budge when it comes to certain things.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know Ichika's wondering how she's supposed to deal with those feelings as a pro moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I want her to cherish them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Isn't this the time for her favorite senior to step in?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Aren't you the only person who can give her the push she needs right now, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, you've been watching over her ever since this SEKAI came into existence, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, she's in the middle of trying to convince herself that she wants you to sing their next song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, I feel that you're the person she wants to talk to right at this moment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I have to agree...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If she'll benefit from me going over to talk to her, then I think I will.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, wish me luck.
